# stats.comparison.PairedComparison { #spotforecast2_safe.stats.comparison.PairedComparison }

```python
stats.comparison.PairedComparison(n, mean_a, mean_b, wins_a, statistic, p_value)
```

Result of `paired_comparison()` — two entries on shared periods.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name      | Type             | Description                                                            |
|-----------|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| n         | [int](`int`)     | Number of shared (paired) periods.                                     |
| mean_a    | [float](`float`) | Mean of the first entry over the shared periods.                       |
| mean_b    | [float](`float`) | Mean of the second entry over the shared periods.                      |
| wins_a    | [int](`int`)     | Number of shared periods on which the first entry was strictly better. |
| statistic | [float](`float`) | Paired t-test statistic.                                               |
| p_value   | [float](`float`) | Two-sided paired t-test p-value.                                       |
